summary: Reasoning-first boolean gate before task list
hypothesis: Forcing the model to explicitly name venting/musing/retractions and commit a boolean (hasActionableTasks) before listing tasks will fix false-positive task invention on non-actionable rambles — because the gate makes the model's intent explicit before it can "drift" into fabricating tasks.
technique: A single greedy on-device call with a reasoning-first @Generable schema: the model must produce a free-text analysis and a hasActionableTasks boolean before the task list is unlocked, gating extraction on an explicit structural commitment.
result: Quality 0.955 on dev-11 (W/T/L vs Sonnet = 0/5/4); specPass 100%; rubric faith=5, atom=5, action=5, cover=4, nonRed=5. KEPT as new best — the boolean gate eliminated false-positive task invention on venting/musing inputs, confirming the hypothesis.

stages.text: Analysis + bool gate, then extract tasks
